exact_statement: For every Boolean sign f on the n-dimensional uniform cube, its one-point surgery g=f-2*f(a)*1_a has the exact signed spectrum, influence, second-derivative and plaquette identities in HIDDEN_TENSOR_DIAGNOSTIC.md sections 1-2, with uniform entropy error E_n=h2(2^(1-floor(n/2)))+n*2^(1-floor(n/2)) for n>=4. Every one-point surgery of a nontrivial coordinate tensor product in n>=2 is tensor-prime and full-Fourier-support. For every fixed nonconstant d-bit Boolean sign h, surgeries G_t of the balanced powers z*h^(tensor t) have H(G_t)/I(G_t)->H(h)/I(h), connected plaquette graphs and cut-plaquette sum 4td*2^(-td-1)->0; thus the simultaneous qualitative class has the same optimal FEI constant as all Boolean signs. These embeddings do not preserve dimension-criticality for a threshold violated by h, since for t>=2 a proper physical restriction away from surgery exposes +/-h.
